privacy.title: Privacy notice
body: Mathzilo stores the minimum: each child's name or nickname, companion, level, answers and stars. It does not store surnames, dates of birth or photos.
For the adult, only the email is stored, and only if a cloud account is created. The PIN is stored as a salted hash; nobody can read it.
Without an account, everything stays on this device. With an account, data is copied to the sync server you choose, encrypted in transit (HTTPS). Each family can only see its own data.
There are no adverts, no third-party analytics and no in-app purchases. The app never handles money: stars are worth whatever the family decides.
You can export all the data or delete it in Settings > Data and privacy. Deleting the account also deletes the server copy.
Data controller: the person who runs the family's server. This notice is a draft and should be reviewed by a professional before the app is used with other families.
